decision.question: Is the edited item corresponding to the central source DVD still visually identifiable as a DVD?
decision.criteria: Examine the source-bound central edited item for visual evidence identifying it as a DVD, including recognizable DVD packaging or optical-disc structure. Pass if the item is visibly identifiable as a DVD despite the color change. Fail if clear visual evidence establishes that it has become a different, non-DVD object. Return unknown if the item is too featureless or ambiguous to establish or exclude DVD identity. Neither an unchanged rectangular outline nor any single feature such as a center hole is mandatory. White color and matching location alone do not establish DVD identity.
